$comment: WAIVERS FOR THE READINESS GATE (scripts/readiness.mjs). Empty by default.
A waiver lets the release build go ahead with one blocker still open. Each
one needs a reason, the name of the person accepting the risk, and an expiry
date; on that date it stops counting and the gate closes again. Every live
waiver is printed in every readiness report and recorded in the release's
readiness.json, so an accepted risk is never invisible.
Legal identity, the registration disclosure, returns, prices, dimensions,
photographs and payment links cannot be waived; a waiver naming one of them
is itself an error that keeps the gate closed.
`path` is optional: without it the waiver covers every finding of that rule.
